text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is selected to be
Umamusume of the
Year.

Past winners will also be at the award
ceremony.
It could be good to speak
with such seasoned
racers, but maybe
it's still too early for her...

Should we look to rub shoulders with the

strongest racers or not? This important
decision
will affect her future.
